construction.access_recipe: Download and unzip FLAT_INV.zip; its text member is FLAT_INV.txt. Parse that member as tab-delimited quoted text with Python csv.reader using a tab delimiter and standard quote handling; map fields 1-11; keep field 1 action numbers starting with PE, field 2 MAKE, field 3 MODEL, field 4 YEAR, field 5 COMPNAME, field 6 MFR_NAME, field 7 ODATE; exclude fields 8 CDATE, 9 CAMPNO, and 11 SUMMARY from features. Download and unzip FLAT_RCL_PRE_2010.zip and FLAT_RCL_POST_2010.zip; the current text members are FLAT_RCL_PRE_2010.txt and FLAT_RCL_POST_2010.txt. Select any non-directory text member whose normalized basename contains rcl rather than requiring a literal RCL.txt. Parse the RCL text member, keep field 2 CAMPNO and field 16 RCDATE. Strip whitespace and uppercase campaign IDs; join on CAMPNO; label 1 when the matched RCDATE is after ODATE and on or before ODATE+730 days. Write one row per PE.
construction.expected_size: FLAT_INV.zip is 4 MB; the live Socrata view has 4,056 investigations, 2,331 of them PE; the 1995-2019 filtered cohort is estimated at 900-1,300 rows; final CSVs under 2 MB.
construction.format: Three CSVs (train.csv, eval.csv, holdout.csv) with identical columns: investigation_id, make, model, model_year, component, manufacturer, model_count, vehicle_age, open_date, label.
construction.source_examples: INV.txt field 1 action numbers in the live data include PE06011 and PE23015; field 4 uses 9999 for unknown; field 7 is YYYYMMDD; field 9 is a CHAR(9) recall campaign number. RCL.txt field 2 is CAMPNO and field 16 is RCDATE.

limitations: Current-vintage retrospective snapshot: the 2026 ODI file may reflect later corrections and does not prove the fields were operationally available in real time during 1995-2019.
CAMPNO attribution is imperfect: one recall may be linked to multiple PEs or models, and a PE may be followed by an EA; using PE only reduces but does not eliminate shared-event dependence.
Recall timing uses RCDATE from the recall file; if CAMPNO is present but unmatched or RCDATE is missing, the row is labeled 0, which can understate escalation.
Territorial limit: Public Domain U.S. Government status rests on 17 U.S.C. § 105 and does not establish worldwide public domain; manufacturer names and trademarks remain third-party.
No production or sales exposure; recall propensity is not normalized by fleet size.
YEAR=9999 is used to exclude equipment, tire, and child-restraint records, but some vehicle PEs with unknown model years are dropped.
reason: NHTSA's ODI preliminary-evaluation file is a directly downloadable, documented federal event table with a future binary outcome (recall linkage), one row per opening, and no account requirement; fixed chronological splits are feasible without panel or lag leakage.

task.decision_user: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation manager allocating investigative resources at PE opening.

features.availability: Present on the opening investigation record; when an action number spans multiple make/model lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies MAKE.
features.meaning: Vehicle make from the deterministic representative line of the PE (INV.txt field 2 MAKE).
features.name: make

features.availability: Present on the opening investigation record; when an action number spans multiple make/model lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies MODEL; the field may contain a list.
features.meaning: Vehicle model or model list from the deterministic representative line of the PE (INV.txt field 3 MODEL).
features.name: model

features.availability: Present as YEAR on the opening record; 9999 is unknown and excluded; values 1900 through 2019 retained. When an action number spans multiple lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies YEAR.
features.meaning: Model year of the representative vehicle line under investigation (INV.txt field 4 YEAR).
features.name: model_year

features.availability: Present as COMPNAME on the opening record; empty values are retained as missing, not zero. When an action number spans multiple lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies COMPNAME.
features.meaning: Component or system description from the deterministic representative line (INV.txt field 5 COMPNAME).
features.name: component

features.availability: Present as MFR_NAME on the opening record; empty values are retained as missing, not zero. When an action number spans multiple lines, the lexicographically first valid line supplies MFR_NAME.
features.meaning: Manufacturer from the deterministic representative line of the PE (INV.txt field 6 MFR_NAME).
features.name: manufacturer

features.availability: Derived from MODEL across all valid lines of the PE; distinct non-empty names are split on comma or semicolon; delimiter interpretation is assumed.
features.meaning: Number of distinct model names across the PE make/model lines, a proxy for the breadth of the PE.
features.name: model_count

features.availability: Derived only from ODATE and the representative line YEAR at opening; negative ages are not clipped.
features.meaning: Open year minus the representative model year, a proxy for vehicle age at the probe.
features.name: vehicle_age

task.population: PE investigations opened 1995-01-01 through 2019-12-31 with a parseable ODATE, non-empty MAKE and MODEL on at least one make/model line, and YEAR from 1900 through 2019; multiple lines sharing an action number are collapsed to one row per action number using the lexicographically first valid line and a model count across lines; excludes YEAR 9999 equipment, tire, and child-restraint records and rows without a parseable ODATE.
task.prediction_time: The PE open date (ODATE), before investigation findings, closure, or a recall campaign number are known.
task.question: Will a newly opened NHTSA preliminary evaluation (PE) into a vehicle defect result in a linked safety recall campaign within 24 months?
task.simple_references: Majority class; manufacturer base rate; component base rate; model-year age-only; open-year base rate.
task.split_policy: Chronological by ODATE: train 1995-01-01 to 2007-12-31; eval 2008-01-01 to 2014-12-31; holdout 2015-01-01 to 2019-12-31. No embargo; each row is a distinct PE and no feature uses another row's outcome. All 24-month label windows close by 2021-12-31, before the 2026 snapshot.
task.target: 1 if the PE record's CAMPNO is non-empty and the linked recall's RCDATE is after ODATE and on or before ODATE + 730 days; 0 otherwise. CAMPNO, CDATE, status, and recall records are label-only and excluded from features.
task.usefulness: At opening, the recall outcome is unknown and CAMPNO is absent; the model must combine component, manufacturer, model-year, and probe breadth to forecast regulatory escalation. This supports triage and is not a copied field.

title: Will a newly opened NHTSA preliminary evaluation produce a safety recall within 24 months?
